content.rationale: S5-undo (qkqkuzxw) and G-select-undo (wwrrqtox) fix which boundary undo names — the most recent applied pair's pre-boundary — and S5-redo (yvtmrnsr) with G-select-redo (qtysmzxy) which post-boundary redo names; S5-undo-effect (zuqzrlrx) and S5-redo-effect (xovuxpvq) fix the whole state each leaves. S5-ordered (kupzywsq), G-order (ukulkqqw) and D15b (qwqwqtuq) fix redo's window — order is visible in markers, so a newer pair while an undo run is open means redo is no longer re-application — S5-pointer-bounds (ltrmwytx) that a count or bound past the pairs is not a valid state, and S5-empty-undo (twmzwwll) and S5-empty-redo (tomomvzw) name the two empty cases. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/markers_guards.rs. It names the state through M-markers' closed types — whose position is the restore target — and its refusals through M-refusal's value. Two transitions over the state alone: undo answers with the undone count one further back and the position at the pre-boundary of the operation it undoes; redo answers with the position at the post-boundary of the next undone operation and the count one forward, the pairs standing. The bound marks D15b's window and is checked where a reader of the file can act on it. No file, no store, no restore: the answer is the state the invocation persists, and a state that cannot answer is a refusal naming its cause, never rendered here.
